text.name: Bird of Perception
text.description:
{Bird of Perception}

Increases your Eagle Eye skill by 5% and grants 6 level 3 creatures per week to the town where the hero is located.
text.event: You notice a small bird figurine lying in the grass. It seems to watch the sky, and griffins answer its call.

text.name: Pendant of Life
text.description:
{Pendant of Life}

Renders your units immune to the Death Ripple spell and grants 24 level 1 creatures per week to the town where the hero is located.
text.event: A warm pendant pulses in your hand, and sprites gather around it.

text.name: Pendant of Death
text.description:
{Pendant of Death}

Renders your undead units immune to the Destroy Undead spell. In addition, all undead stacks in the hero's army gain +2 Attack and +2 Defense.
text.event: The pendant grows cold, and shambling shapes follow you out of the dark.

text.name: Pendant of Total Recall
text.event: You pick up the Pendant of Total Recall.

text.name: Emblem of Cognizance
text.description:
{Emblem of Cognizance}

Increases your Eagle Eye skill by 15% and produces 2 gold per day for every creature in the hero's army.
text.event: Your troops notice that nothing escapes your gaze, and they stop pocketing the loot.

text.name: Stoic Watchman
text.event: The stone figure's eyes seem to follow the horizon, and your own sight follows.

text.name: Pendant of Second Sight
text.description:
{Pendant of Second Sight}

Immunity to Blind. Free upgrades in the hero's army: Archers, Wood Elves, Gremlins, Gogs, Beholders, Orcs, Lizardmen and Air Elementals. At the start of every battle casts Expert Air Shield.
text.event: You pick up the Pendant of Second Sight.

text.name: Pendant of Holiness
text.description:
{Pendant of Holiness}

Immunity to Curse. Teaches your hero: Bless, Cure, Prayer. At the start of every battle casts Expert Bless.
text.event: You pick up the Pendant of Holiness.

text.name: Boots of Polarity
text.description:
{Boots of Polarity}

Increases your Magic Resistance by 15% and gives a small amount of land movement points.
text.event: Your steps feel strangely light in these boots.

text.name: Garniture of Interference
text.event: The garniture hums, and spells come to you more easily.

text.name: Pendant of Dispassion
text.description:
{Pendant of Dispassion}

Immunity to Berserk. +1 Knowledge. At the start of every battle casts Expert Bloodlust.
text.event: You pick up the Pendant of Dispassion.

text.name: Pendant of Free Will
text.description:
{Pendant of Free Will}

Immunity to Hypnotize. Free upgrades: Peasants to Rogues, Stone Golems to Iron, Gold and Diamond Golems. At the start of every battle casts Expert Stone Skin.
text.event: You pick up the Pendant of Free Will.

text.name: Diplomat's Ring
text.description:
{Diplomat's Ring}

Reduces the cost of surrendering by 10% and produces 500 gold per day.
text.event: The ring glints, and recruits seem eager to follow you.

text.name: Surcoat of Counterpoise
text.description:
{Surcoat of Counterpoise}

Increases your Magic Resistance by 10%, your Knowledge by 1 and your scouting radius by 3, and produces 1000 gold per day.
text.event: The surcoat grows warm, then cold, then warm again. It is clearly doing something.

text.name: Orb of Vulnerability
text.description:
{Orb of Vulnerability}

Negates the natural magic resistance of all creatures on the battlefield. 1 level 6 creature per week to the town where the hero is located. At the start of every battle casts Expert Disease on all enemy troops.
text.event: You pick up the Orb of Vulnerability.

text.name: Sphere of Permanence
text.description:
{Sphere of Permanence}

Renders your units immune to the Dispel Magic spell and grants 2 level 5 creatures per week to the town where the hero is located.
text.event: The sphere steadies your constructs, and they stand more firmly.

text.name: Statesman's Medal
text.description:
{Statesman's Medal}

Reduces the cost of surrendering by 10% and produces 500 gold per day.
text.event: The medal lends weight to your words, and to your treasury.

text.name: Targ of the Rampaging Ogre
text.description:
{Targ of the Rampaging Ogre}

Increases your Defense skill by 5 and increases all experience your hero gains by 5%.
text.event: The shield still carries the smell of ogre camps.

text.name: Dead Man's Boots
text.description:
{Dead Man's Boots}

Increases your Necromancy skill by 15% and gives all undead stacks in the hero's army +2 Speed.
text.event: Eventually, everyone dies...

text.name: Orb of the Firmament
text.description:
{Orb of the Firmament}

Increases the damage of your Air Magic spells by 50%. At the start of every battle casts Expert Protection from Air on all your troops.
text.event: You pick up the Orb of the Firmament.

text.name: Orb of Silt
text.description:
{Orb of Silt}

Increases the damage of your Earth Magic spells by 50%. At the start of every battle casts Expert Protection from Earth on all your troops.
text.event: You pick up the Orb of Silt.

text.name: Orb of Tempestuous Fire
text.description:
{Orb of Tempestuous Fire}

Increases the damage of your Fire Magic spells by 50%. At the start of every battle casts Expert Protection from Fire on all your troops.
text.event: You pick up the Orb of Tempestuous Fire.

text.name: Orb of Driving Rain
text.description:
{Orb of Driving Rain}

Increases the damage of your Water Magic spells by 50%. At the start of every battle casts Expert Protection from Water on all your troops.
text.event: You pick up the Orb of Driving Rain.

text.name: Ambassador's Sash
text.description:
{Ambassador's Sash}

Reduces the cost of surrendering by 10% and produces 500 gold per day.
text.event: You pick up the Ambassador's Sash, and your words carry weight in any negotiation.
